sentences.en: Provided you have a reservation, you can check in anytime.
sentences.zh: 如果你有预订，随时都可以办理入住。

sentences.en: I will accept the work, provided that you help me.
sentences.zh: 我接受这份工作，前提是你帮我一下。

sentences.en: I will call you up, provided that I have time.
sentences.zh: 如果有时间的话，我会给你打电话。

senses.zh: 提供，给予（provide 的过去式和过去分词）
